Case: Patient D is a 75-year-old Asian man with history of lung cancer and 4 months of progressive low-back and right leg pain. Upon reviewing his lumbar spine MRI, you identify diffuse leptomeningeal disease.
Question: Would you offer morphine to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
